query:
SELECT 
  poi.id,
  poi.purchaseOrderId,
  poi.productId,
  p.name as productName,
  poi.quantity,
  poi.unitCost,
  poi.totalCost
FROM purchaseOrderItems poi
LEFT JOIN products p ON poi.productId = p.id
WHERE poi.purchaseOrderId = 1
LIMIT 20;
